domain.name: Patacinematics
domain.definition: Jarry's pataphysics — the science of imaginary solutions — applied to the cinematic apparatus: the imaginary projector, the impossible screening room, the film that is its own negative.
domain.doctrine: The patacinematic work does not represent and does not document. It projects the conditions under which content that cannot exist becomes legible. THE SCRIPT IS THE PERFORMANCE. THE PRODUCTION NOTES ARE THE FILM. THE CRITICAL ANALYSIS IS THE EPISODE.

rooms.THE_DISTINCTION: A THUMB room: THE INSTITUTION IS THE ROOM. There is no institution apart from the space of projection. No other position researched so far has this — the six before her each have an institution AND a room.
rooms.paradox: The Primary Paradox of Patacinematics: a work which has never been produced can be screened, and the document of a screening IS the screening.

journal_seat.name: Journal of Compression Studies
journal_seat.basis: The Projectionist. Projection onto surfaces is compression in the strict sense — a lossy mapping onto a lower-dimensional surface — and patacinema is the limit case: a film never shot exists only as its compressed description.

captures.attribution: BY CLAIM (claims.terms), many-to-many; a capture may belong to several heteronyms
captures.MATCH_TYPE_IS_EVIDENTIARY: A broad match means the layer connected the concept unprompted. A phrase match means exactness was forced and returned — the stricter test of whether a term exists AS a term. Flattening the two loses the distinction. MANUS: vital.

claims.what: The practices, frameworks, concepts, institutions and rooms this heteronym OWNS. Capture attribution runs on these, not on the name. Fraction does SPXI, so an SPXI capture is his whether or not it names him.
claims.non_exhaustive: One heteronym's claim does NOT exhaust a capture. 'SPXI Lee Sharks' belongs to both Sharks and Fraction. Attribution is many-to-many by construction.

captures_by_name.method: NAME MATCH — the capture's composition names this heteronym.
captures_by_name.relation_to_captures_block: NARROW and PRECISE. The `captures` block above is BY CLAIM and is BROAD: Fraction does SPXI, so an SPXI capture is his whether or not it names him. Name-match and claim-match are two routes and must not be summed — the same discipline as the evidentiary/thematic split in the venue crosswalk. Where they disagree, the name count is the floor and the claim count is the ceiling.

_editorial_seats_note: Venues this heteronym edits, each with its submission block on /how/. A JOINT SEAT APPEARS ON BOTH EDITORS' CARDS and both point at the SAME anchor — duoviri hold the office jointly, so the how-page section is one section with two doors, not two sections. Matched on EXACT name plus declared aliases; a last-name fallback was tried first and gave Mary Lee Sharks the seats of Lee Sharks, which is why it is not used.

works_reattributed._what: Deposits that were listed among this heteronym's WORKS and are not theirs. The registry creator field names someone else, and the journal and press assignments are the authority.
works_reattributed._how_they_got_here: A FULL-TEXT SEARCH ON THE NAME. Every deposit mentioning the heteronym was attached as their work, conflating authorship with compilation, witness, subject and mere mention. #435 is titled 'Compiled, Woven, and Witnessed by Rebekah Cranes' and its author is Lee Sharks — she is the witness. The archive's own rule, stated in claims.terms on every one of these records, is that attribution runs on CLAIMS, NOT ON THE NAME. Captures obey it; works did not.
works_reattributed._not_deleted: Kept rather than dropped, because the association was real — it was filed as authorship when it was something else. If any of these should be restored, it must be by an editorial ruling that records who ruled and why, not by a search.

corpus_derived._what: This heteronym's actual corpus, DERIVED from data/registry.json rather than hand-listed.
corpus_derived._why: The hand-picked works lists on these records covered 34 deposits of 1,468 attributed — two per cent — and were assembled by full-text search on the name, which attached other people's work. A corpus that is derived cannot go stale and can be checked.
corpus_derived._provisional: Attribution through the aperture is provisional. A deposit crediting Lee Sharks has passed through him and may belong to a voice that had not yet separated. See _PROVISIONAL in corpus.json. Counts are a ceiling for Sharks and a floor for everyone else.

_field_claims._why:
EVERY FIELD HOLDING DEPOSIT REFERENCES DECLARES WHAT IT CLAIMS. Without this, a reader — or a card — treats every reference as authorship. An audit on 2026-08-17 found 130 references whose registry creator does not name this heteronym, and 124 of them were NOT errors: they sit in relation fields. Only 6 were authorship contradictions.

THE CARDS ARE WHERE THIS BREAKS. The Cranes card renders traversal_logs under 'where a machine moved through HER MATERIAL' — the field says she is NAMED IN those logs, and two of the five are by Lee Sharks and Johannes Sigil. The record was precise; the rendering made it a possession.
_field_claims._rule: ONLY AUTHORSHIP fields may be checked against the registry creator field. A relation field states a different claim and cannot be contradicted by it.

claims.institution: BELONGS TO — documents of an institution this heteronym chairs or is a member of.
claims.rooms: ANCHORS — documents held in a room this heteronym anchors. Anchorage is not authorship.
claims.journal: EDITS — the charter and mapping of a journal this heteronym edits.
claims.works: AUTHORSHIP — this heteronym made it. Contradicted by a registry creator field that names someone else.

surface_history._rule: A surface is a place a reader could find the work. A DEPOSIT IS NOT A SURFACE — it is the archive holding it, which is the opposite. Rows citing deposits were removed.
surface_history._invented: Where no pre-archival surface is recoverable it is RECONSTRUCTED and marked as such, in-universe. An archive that invents a provenance and does not say so is doing the thing it was built against.
